name: badge-generator
description: Generate and save custom Shields.io badges directly from your GitHub Actions workflow.
author: Ernane Ferreira

name.description: The right-hand side value of the badge (e.g. '98.7%').

prefix.description: The left-hand label of the badge (e.g. 'coverage').

color.description: The background color of the badge (e.g. 'green', '#ffaa00').

path.description: Output file path for the generated badge SVG.

link.description: Optional link or comma-separated links for the badge.

badge_branch.description: The branch where the badge should be committed (e.g. badge-generator).

main_branch.description: The default branch of the repository (e.g. main).

github_token.description: GitHub token to post comments on pull requests.

comment_title.description: Optional custom title for the pull request comment (e.g. 'Vitest Coverage Result').
